$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor autocomplete and validation.

baseUrl.description: Base URL prepended to every relative tutorial and step URL, e.g. "https://app.example.com".

defaultDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait after each action before capturing, unless a step sets its own `delay`.

theme.description: Color scheme for recording: "dark" or "light". Defaults to browser default.

tutorials.description: Tutorials to record, keyed by a short slug that becomes the output file name.

viewport.description: Browser viewport in CSS pixels. Ignored when `format` names a preset.

ArrowConfig.description: Arrow config — resolved from two CSS selectors to element center points.

color.description: Arrow color as a CSS color value.

curvature.description: Curve amount from -1.0 (bend left) to 1.0 (bend right); 0 is straight.

fromSelector.description: CSS selector of the element the arrow starts from.

toSelector.description: CSS selector of the element the arrow points to.

BlurConfig.description: Blur region config — resolved from CSS selector to element bounds.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to blur.

DemoFormat.description: Preset format for demo recording viewport dimensions.

ElementBounds.description:
Pixel coordinates for a highlight region.

The optional `z_index` is only meaningful when `ElementBounds` is used directly
as an overlay (e.g. `BundleManifestStep.blur_regions`). When nested as a sub-`bounds`
field on another overlay (e.g. `HighlightEntry.bounds`, `ZoomRegion.bounds`), the
overlay's own `z_index` governs paint order and this field stays `None`.

HighlightConfig.description: Highlight config for a step in the recording config.

arrow.description: Draw an arrow from the callout to the element.

bounds.description: Explicit pixel bounds. When set, wins over selector resolution.

callout.description: Text shown in a callout next to the highlight.

color.description: Highlight color as a CSS color value, e.g. "#7c3aed".

position.description: Where the callout is placed relative to the element: top, bottom, left, or right.

showBorder.description: Draw a border around the highlighted element (defaults to true).

HotspotConfig.description: Hotspot config — resolved from CSS selector to element center point.

callout.description: Text shown in a callout next to the hotspot.

color.description: Hotspot color as a CSS color value.

isClickTarget.description: Whether clicking the hotspot advances the demo.

position.description: Where the callout is placed relative to the element: top, bottom, left, or right.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element the hotspot is centered on.

PopupConfig.description: Popup config — resolved from CSS selector to element center point.

buttonText.description: Optional button label displayed at the bottom of the popup.

buttonUrl.description: Optional URL the button links to.

color.description: Background color as a CSS color value.

openInNewTab.description: Whether the button opens in a new tab.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element the popup is anchored to.

textColor.description: Text color as a CSS color value.

oneOf.description:
A guided tour: interactive steps need highlight callouts, and the
recorder scaffolds `tours/<key>.tour.json` after recording.

StepConfig.description: A single step action in a tutorial.

action.description: What this step does: click, type, key, scroll, scroll-to, hover, navigate, wait, or select.

arrows.description: Arrows drawn between two elements on this step's screenshot.

blurRegions.description: Regions blurred on this step's screenshot (e.g. to hide sensitive data).

delay.description: Milliseconds to wait after this action, overriding the config `defaultDelay`.

highlightSelector.description:
Optional CSS selector used only for resolving highlight bounds.
When set, overrides `selector` for highlight resolution so that
action steps (scroll, navigate) can target one element while
highlighting another.

highlights.description: Highlight annotations drawn on this step's screenshot.

hotspots.description: Pulsing hotspot markers placed on elements.

key.description: Key to press for the "key" action, e.g. "Enter" or "Escape".

name.description: Optional label for the step, shown in progress output and the dashboard.

sceneScrollX.description: Horizontal scroll position the page is restored to before this step's capture.

sceneScrollY.description: Vertical scroll position the page is restored to before this step's capture.

scrollX.description: Horizontal scroll distance in pixels for the "scroll" action.

scrollY.description: Vertical scroll distance in pixels for the "scroll" action.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element this action targets. Required for click, type, hover, and select.

selectorQuality.description: How the selector was derived (informational, set by recording tools).

text.description: Text to enter. Required for the "type" action. Supports `${ENV_VAR}` interpolation.

url.description: Target URL for the "navigate" action — absolute, or relative to `baseUrl`.

value.description: Option value to choose for the "select" action.

zoomRegions.description: Regions the viewer zooms into on this step.

TutorialConfig.description: A single tutorial within the config.

description.description: Optional longer description of what the tutorial shows.

steps.description: Ordered actions to perform; each step becomes one screenshot in the demo.

target.description:
What this tutorial records for: a screenshot "demo" (default) or a
guided "tour". Tour recordings warn about interactive steps without a
callout (the tour projection drops them) and scaffold
`tours/<key>.tour.json` after recording.

title.description: Human-readable title, shown in the dashboard and used as the demo title on upload.

url.description: Start page for the tutorial — absolute, or relative to the config `baseUrl`.

deviceScaleFactor.description: Device pixel ratio, e.g. 2.0 for retina-quality screenshots.

ZoomConfig.description: Zoom region config — resolved from CSS selector to element bounds.

delay.description: Zoom animation start delay in milliseconds.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to zoom into.
